Netanyahu Visits UAE Amid Security Concerns and Election Campaign

Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu made a secret visit to the United Arab Emirates (UAE) to meet with President Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed in Abu Dhabi. The visit, which occurred shortly before Israel's election weeks, focused on strengthening bilateral relations. The meeting also took place amid disputed reports that Sheikh Mohamed had warned Netanyahu about Hamas prior to the October 7, 2023 attacks. Netanyahu's office confirmed the trip, stating it was to bolster ties. Separately, an incident involving a co-pilot attacking an Indian captain on a Flydubai flight was reported, with one outlet suggesting a plot was foiled.
